parts.text: The heavy rainfall caused a flood in the marshland and swept Freddie Frog 300 yards away from his dwelling in the bog.
To get back home, he will have to leap and paddle his way back.

If he leaps on land at a speed of 30 yards per minute, and paddles through water at a speed of 15 yards per minute, how long will it take Freddie, in minutes, to return home if half of the distance is on land and the other half is in water?
